mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad-based economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in at least 60% of observed instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 115.0) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), the economy enters stagflation where corporate margins contract, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 115.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in at least 60% of observed instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 120.0) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), the economy enters strong expansion where corporate profits grow, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 120.0 and UNRATE < 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
